description: S462 Q11 — a server call (the compiler awaits it) is a suspension point: another handler may write `@user` while it waits, so the narrowing of every reactive cell ends there; the later bare `@user.name` is E-TYPE-046.
rationale: §42.3.5 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a", Q11): "A suspension point — a server call (compiler-inserted await), a body-split boundary, or a `yield` — ENDS the narrowing of every reactive cell from that point"
